description.value: The study examined whether IL-10 promoter ATA haplotype status and amnestic mild cognitive impairment are associated with differences in bilateral hippocampal functional connectivity and whether connectivity relates to memory performance.

spans.text: Notably, regions associated with group × haplotypes interactions in the left hippocampal network were mainly located in the frontoparietal cortices (i.e., bilateral precentral gyrus, postcentral gyrus and paracentral lobule) ( Table 2 ; Fig. 3 ).

design.value: A 2 × 2 voxel-wise ANOVA examined groups (aMCI and controls) by IL-10 haplotype (without ATA haplotype and with ATA haplotype) using bilateral hippocampal voxel-wise functional connectivity, followed by post-hoc group comparisons and correlations with neuropsychological scores.

spans.text: A voxel-wise analysis of variance (ANOVA: groups × haplotypes; groups: aMCI and controls; haplotypes: without ATA haplotype and with ATA haplotype ) was performed.

steps.value: discard first eight volumes; timing correction; motion correction; spatial normalization; resampling; Gaussian smoothing; linear detrending; temporal bandpass filtering

spans.text: The first eight volumes of the scanning session were discarded to allow for T1 equilibration effects. The remaining images were corrected for timing differences and motion effects. Participants with head motion of > 3 mm maximum displacement along any axis, or 3° of any type of angular motion were excluded. The resulting images were spatially normalized into the SPM5 Montreal Neurological Institute echo-planar imaging template using default settings and resampling to 3 × 3 × 3 mm 3 voxels. The normalized images were smoothed with a Gaussian kernel of 8 × 8 × 8 mm 3 . Then, REST software ... was used to remove the linear trend of time courses and for temporal bandpass filtering (0.01–0.08 Hz).
